name: Radolinski Delivan Shipping
author: Szymon Radoliński

sections.description:
The plugin connects your WooCommerce store with the Delivan.pl courier broker. Delivan brings the leading Polish and international carriers under a single account — you offer your customers multiple shipping options without signing separate contracts with each courier.

Supported carriers (via the Delivan broker): InPost, DPD, DHL, UPS, GLS, FedEx, ORLEN Paczka, Pocztex, Poczta Polska, Meest.

The plugin adds shipping methods to your store, lets customers pick a parcel locker or pickup point on a map during checkout, and every order is automatically forwarded to Delivan as a draft shipment that you approve in the Delivan panel.

The plugin is available in English and Polish (the interface follows your WordPress site language).

Opis po polsku

Wtyczka łączy sklep WooCommerce z brokerem kurierskim Delivan.pl. Delivan zbiera czołowych przewoźników polskich i międzynarodowych pod jednym kontem — oferujesz klientom wiele opcji wysyłki bez podpisywania osobnych umów z każdym kurierem.

Wtyczka dodaje metody wysyłki do sklepu, pozwala klientom wybrać paczkomat lub punkt odbioru na mapie w trakcie zamówienia, a każde zamówienie jest automatycznie przekazywane do Delivan jako wersja robocza przesyłki, którą zatwierdzasz w panelu Delivan.

Wtyczka dostępna jest w języku polskim i angielskim (interfejs podąża za językiem witryny WordPress).

External services

The plugin requires a Delivan.pl account and connects to the Delivan API (https://delivan.pl/api/v1) to fetch pickup point locations, submit orders, and synchronize data.

  • Delivan.pl Terms of Service
  • Delivan.pl Privacy Policy

Bundled third-party JavaScript libraries:

  • Leaflet v1.9.4 — BSD-2-Clause
  • Leaflet.markercluster v1.5.3 — MIT
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress directory or upload the radolinski-delivan-shipping folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → Delivan and enter the Client ID and Client Secret from your Delivan panel (Settings → API Keys).
  4. In Shipping zones add the “Delivan Shipping” method and configure the price, carriers, and delivery type (courier / pickup point).
sections.faq:
Do I need a Delivan account?

Yes — sign up at Delivan.pl and generate API keys under Settings → API Keys.

Can I assign multiple carriers to a single shipping method?

Yes. Enter carrier codes separated by commas (e.g. inpost, dpd, orlen). Delivan will pick the cheapest available option.

Does the plugin work with the WooCommerce Blocks checkout?

Yes — both the classic checkout and the new block-based checkout are supported.

In which languages is the plugin available? / W jakich językach dostępna jest wtyczka?

English and Polish. The plugin follows your WordPress site language (Settings → General → Site Language). / Angielskim i polskim. Wtyczka podąża za językiem witryny WordPress (Ustawienia → Ogólne → Język witryny).
sections.changelog:
2.5.0

  • Full internationalization: English is now the source language, with a complete Polish (pl_PL) translation bundled. The plugin follows the WordPress site language.
  • Pełna internacjonalizacja: językiem źródłowym jest angielski, dołączone kompletne polskie tłumaczenie (pl_PL). Wtyczka podąża za językiem witryny WordPress.

2.4.22

  • Inline JavaScript moved from PHP to separate files loaded via wp_enqueue_script().

2.4.21

  • Display name, author and contributors aligned with WordPress.org directory requirements.

2.4.20

  • Hardened pickup point cache flushing in the admin panel.

2.4.19

  • Text domain and folder name aligned with the assigned slug.

2.4.18

  • Removed redundant Plugin URI header.
  • Removed built-in auto-update mechanism — updates come from WordPress.org.

2.0.0

  • Architecture rebuild, WordPress.org guidelines compliance, full internationalization.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
